declared_base: Rahlfs–Hanhart Septuaginta, second revised edition (2006), provisional continuation authorized by the user
scope: All 959 inherited English units read for editorial review. Selected main-text inspections only; no new full-book Greek collation or independent specialist review.

checks.result: Commands address human recipients. The source commandment order, with adultery before murder, remains.
The preface, heart and soul, immovable sign and mercy wording remain. The English forms of address follow the Bespoke convention.
The two negatives in 9:23 are explicit in revised English. The direct prayer, including King of the gods and repeated strength language, remains.
The shifts between prayer and surrounding instructions were inspected. Direct divine address is retained, alongside ordinary you/your in the instructions. The second tithe remains.

checks.scope: Selected 32:2–9, 32:18, 32:24, 32:29, 32:39 and 32:43; chapter main-text windows retrieved
checks.result: Inherited angels of God, difficult bodily imagery and expanded ending remain. Repeated See is retained. No apparatus choice or full syntactic verification is claimed.
Shifts of addressee and the human quotation in 33:9 were inspected. Divine-address capitals remain editorial. Manifestations, wrath and the one-horned animal remain provisional.
Plural burial agents, Gai, cheeks and spirit of understanding remain. The difficult lexical choices still require specialist review.
